name: Dr. Rukmini Mridula Kandadai
verified_role: Senior Consultant Neurologist and Clinical Director, PDMDRC (Parkinson's Disease and Movement Disorders Research Centre), Yashoda Hospitals, Hitec City, Hyderabad. Specialises in Parkinson's disease and movement disorders, deep brain stimulation, neurodegeneration, epilepsy and stroke. Formerly Additional/Associate/Assistant Professor of Neurology at NIMS, Hyderabad.
verified_experience: 26 years (Yashoda official profile). DNB (General Medicine) and DM (Neurology) from NIMS Hyderabad; MBBS from Kasturba Medical College, Manipal (1994-1999).
hni_signals: Clinical Director of a named research centre (PDMDRC - Parkinson's Disease & Movement Disorders Research Centre) at a major corporate hospital - strong leadership signal. Founding member and Executive Committee member of the Movement Disorders Society of India; Founding Member & Treasurer of the Parkinson's Research Alliance of India; Membership Committee member of the International Parkinson and Movement Disorders Society (2021-2023). Gold medallist (pathology) and best outgoing lady medical graduate at Kasturba Medical College, Manipal. Former Additional Professor of Neurology at NIMS Hyderabad with a strong research record (maintains a ResearchGate profile).
